title: hub.log Request Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Add a "device health" log message to send to Notehub on the next sync via the [_health_host.qo Notefile](/api-reference/system-notefiles/#healthhost-qo).

alert.description: `true` if the message is urgent. This doesn't change how the Notecard handles the message. It adds `"alert":true` to the logged Note, so you can act on it after the Note reaches Notehub.

sync.description: `true` to sync the log message to Notehub immediately. Setting `true` also removes the Notecard from certain types of [penalty boxes](/support/understanding-notecard-penalty-boxes/).

text.description: Text to log. If omitted, nothing is logged.

samples.title: Log Health Alert with Immediate Sync
samples.description: Log an urgent health alert and sync immediately.
